description: This file defines a jQuery plugin 'ImportView' for handling email import UI interactions in SuiteCRM, including message box display, AJAX loading of import view, and event handling.

methods.name: ImportView
methods.description: Initializes the email import view, sets up event handlers, and manages message box interactions.

methods.description: Sets up event listeners and triggers the 'constructImportView' event.

methods.name: showMessageBox
methods.description: Displays a message box for email import, loads import view via AJAX, and handles user interactions.
